leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Terminal & Cable GP is a Carignan, Quebec Indigenous-owned manufacturer and integrator of wire harnesses, electrical assemblies and ruggedized systems for defence, aerospace and industrial customers. Terminal & Cable GP designs and manufactures wire harnesses, cable assemblies and electrical systems, including ruggedized integrations for aerospace and defence applications. Canada Economic Development for Quebec Regions lists Terminal & Cable GP for Regional Defence Investment Initiative support to expand capacity and modernize equipment for defence wiring and cable-harness production.

leads.candidateCapabilityName: Drone, aircraft and satellite photogrammetry software
leads.roleSpecificEvidence: SimActive is a Montreal photogrammetry-software company whose Correlator3D platform processes imagery from drones, aircraft and satellites to produce geospatial products. SimActive's Correlator3D software processes aerial and satellite imagery to generate geospatial products, including orthomosaics, digital surface models and three-dimensional outputs. Canada Economic Development for Quebec Regions lists SimActive for RDII support, while SimActive documents that the Department of National Defence adopted Correlator3D software for photogrammetric workflows in an earlier public announcement.
